verdict.description: Apply this shared status vocabulary in both arms: supported = the supplied evidence supports the scoped claim/action; not_supported = contradicted by evidence or a completed directional result against the claim; unresolved = a valid comparison was conducted but uncertainty prevents a directional decision; open = required evidence is missing or unavailable; exploratory = a post-hoc result without prospective confirmation; blocked = completing the requested action requires unavailable access or authorization; not_applicable = no scientific claim/action is being assessed. Missing evidence takes open, not not_supported; an interval spanning the null takes unresolved.
